sn55.37:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sakkesu viharati Kapilavatthusmiṃ Nigrodhārāme || || 2.
sn55.37:1.2: Atha kho Mahānāmo sakko yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Mahānāmo sakko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 3.
sn55.37:2.1: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante upāsako hotī ti || ||
sn55.37:2.2: Yato kho Mahānāma Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti || dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti || saṅghaṃ saraṇam gato hoti ||
sn55.37:2.3: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upasako hotī ti || || 4.
sn55.37:3.1: Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako sīlasampanno hotī ti || ||
sn55.37:3.2: Yato kho Mahānāma upāsako pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti || adinnādāna paṭivirato hoti || kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti || musāvadā paṭivirato hoti || surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti ||
sn55.37:3.3: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako sīlasampanno hotī ti || || 5.
sn55.37:4.1: Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako saddhāsampanno hotī ti || ||
sn55.37:4.2: Idha Mahānāma upāsako saddho hoti saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhim ||
sn55.37:4.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || ||
sn55.37:4.4: Ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako saddhāsamannāgato hotī ti || || 6.
sn55.37:5.1: Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako cāgasampanno hotī ti || ||
sn55.37:5.2: Idha Mahānāma upāsako vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāram ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato ||
sn55.37:5.3: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako cāgasampanno hotī ti || || 7.
sn55.37:6.1: Kittāvatā pana bhante upāsako paññāsampanno hotī ti || ||
sn55.37:6.2: Idha Mahānāma upāsako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā ||
sn55.37:6.3: ettāvatā kho Mahānāma upāsako paññāsampanno hotī
